stemMd: What additional effect of frequent turning was suggested after the dry spell?

options.label: A
options.textMd: An increase in the number of plastic containers.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The complete absence of air in the turned heap.

options.label: D
options.textMd: A change from compost to metal.

explanationMd: The passage says measurements suggested more moisture loss from frequent turning. This added a second mechanism to the initial aeration explanation and helped account for the later cooling.

distractorRationale.e: The turned heap cooled more quickly later.
distractorRationale.d: No material transformation of that kind occurs.
distractorRationale.c: Turning was considered in relation to improved air supply.
